## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC Transaction Agreement and form-of TRA

- 2020-08-02: Transaction Agreement executed between CF Finance Acquisition Corp, Grosvenor Holdings, L.L.C., and affiliated GCM Grosvenor entities; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit E to the Transaction Agreement.
- 2020-08-04: 8-K/A files the Transaction Agreement as Exhibit 2.1.
- 2020-10-15: DEFM14A files the form-of Tax Receivable Agreement as Annex F. Preamble date and signatures blank.

#### Business combination close (expected, off-CIK)

- 2020-11-17?: Business combination closes per public record; executed TRA expected to be filed in a Super 8-K under GCM Grosvenor Inc.'s post-close CIK 0001819796. Not observable from filings in this directory.

## Explanation

This file documents only the form-of Tax Receivable Agreement filed as Annex F to CF Finance Acquisition Corp's October 15, 2020 DEFM14A. CFAC was a Cantor Fitzgerald-sponsored blank-check SPAC that combined with GCM Grosvenor to form GCM Grosvenor Inc. on November 17, 2020; the executed TRA was filed under the post-close entity's CIK, which is not part of this directory. The form-of contemplates a standard 85% Up-C TRA with the Grosvenor Capital Management Holdings, LLLP members as beneficiaries, covering Section 754 basis step-ups from exchanges of LLLP common units plus Other Tax Assets and imputed interest. Status is set to `Unknown` because the executed contract, subsequent amendments, and any termination cannot be determined from filings under CFAC's CIK; a future tra-download-filings run on GCM Grosvenor Inc. (CIK 0001819796) is needed to verify execution and current state. See `contract_log.md` for the coverage-gap analysis.
